'''Rhea Avin''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident.

== Appearance ==
She is pretty, with a round face. Her dark hair is braided to her waist. 

== Activities ==
[[Faile Bashere]] sends Rhea and [[Sharmad Zeffar]] to [[Daise Congar]] after they have been fighting over [[Wil al'Seen]].
